data.name: RDC Story Papers
data.shortDescription: Adds an interface to allow custom translations for each story note.
data.description:
🛠️ What does the mod do?
It adds a translation interface that opens when you press the "T" key while holding a story slip.
It allows you to modify what each character says on those slips using text files.

     🌍 How do I use it?
Install the mod and open the game.

The game automatically generates a translation file in the RDCStoryPapers/Translations folder.

You can create a folder for your language (for example, en-en for English) and write your own translations.

From the mod's options menu, enter the name of your folder to load it.

     🐞 Important note
Currently, the translation panel opens with the "T" key even when you're not viewing a slip, which is a minor bug.
